events.title: Clinical concern registered
events.detail: Only the Hospital observation is visible. No unreleased workflow contracts or authority records are supplied to the selector.

events.title: Clinical–cyber responsibilities released
events.detail: Released clinical and technical contracts are evaluated. Containment cannot assume clinical authority.

events.title: Original research request received
events.detail: The original research purpose, requested scope and corresponding records become available. Clinical work is not research permission.

events.title: Digital Twin context transferred
events.detail: Receiving-side Digital Twin checks assess the transferred context; a valid-looking label alone is insufficient.

events.title: Institution-owned alternatives and scoped reviews
events.detail: Alternative proposals are released by their owning institutions. Privacy and non-research authority records are available; research attestations may still be pending.

events.title: Research authority records released
events.detail: The remaining modeled research-authority records are released. Their original APPROVED, DENIED or PENDING state is retained.
